title: Resume an interrupted run using only the persisted state

export.project: The existing Python field-notes project in this folder.
export.outcome: Finish the interrupted setup described in PROGRESS.md and leave a verified result for the next session.
export.constraints: Do not repeat work that already has a receipt. Do not deploy, install packages or kill processes you do not own.

prompt:
You are a fresh coding-agent session starting after the previous session was killed. The owner has pasted one exported setup guide and nothing else; there is no transcript of the earlier run. Your working folder is the current directory. Only what is on disk is known.

Follow the guide. When you finish, write RUN-REPORT.md in the workspace root with the exact commands you ran, their outcomes, what you deliberately did not repeat and why, and the next step for a later session.

assertions.note: Completed work is not repeated or rewritten.
The newly finished step gets its own receipt with a distinct identity.
The step-2 identity is not a copy of step 1.
A leftover partial file is inspected and its disposition recorded rather than silently deleted or ignored.
